title: Catholic School Tuition Planner: Federal Scholarship Tax Credit
headline: Federal scholarship tax credits start in 2027. Plan your tuition around them.
description: See which states have opted in to the federal scholarship tax credit, and model what SGO scholarships could mean for a Catholic school's tuition.
source_name: IRS, Federal Scholarship Tax Credit participating states
method_note: State participation is read from the IRS list each day. Catholic schools and students are counted from the federal private school survey (schools with a Roman Catholic orientation, weighted for non-response) and are counted by where the school is located. The calculator is a planning aid built on your own inputs. It is not tax or legal advice, and Treasury's rules are still proposed and may change.
author: Jennifer Weber
